_what: The account screen's own words (web/account-guide.ts lays them out on the shared guide); the sign-in's words it shares with the /account page stay in pages/words.json. {name} is filled from the account. `browsers` and `systems` name a signed-in device from its browser's user agent: the first row whose `match` the user agent holds wins. Where each part came from: the guide layout (sections of rows, each with a status and its actions, a confirm asked in place) is the first platform repository's Account & security screen's (src/account-screens.mjs, drawn by the guide); Sessions with this device marked and the others with Sign out, and Passkeys with Add at the section, are Linear's and Railway's security settings on Mobbin; Delete account last in the danger tone with a password box is the 21st.dev Account Settings Danger Zone (id 46773) and Delete Account Form (id 25081).
title: Account
lead: Your name and email, how you sign in, and where you are signed in.
